top_signals.title: VW Cuts Profit Outlook After China Sales Slump, Costs Rise
top_signals.summary: Volkswagen AG lowered its operating margin forecast, reflecting a sharp contraction in the Chinese car market and costs related to its job-cutting plan. The carmaker also cited a €6 billion ($6.9 billion) writedown on the value of its stake in Porsche AG.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Mbappé Signs with On
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg’s Randall Williams says Kylian Mbappé’s move from Nike to On is a major statement for the young Swiss sportswear company and a notable loss for Nike. Top athletes rarely leave Nike in their prime, making Mbappé’s switch especially unusual. The discussion touched on On’s lightweight shoe technology, its manufacturing approach, and the challenge of growing beyond products like cleats that are limited to specific use cases.  (Source: Bloomberg)
